title: He had shaken the thurible only slightly like such a one, his chasuble had swung open
html_source:
In this moment, Stephen is imagining what his life would be like if he became a priest. During a traditional Roman Catholic mass, many specific items are used. Here Stephen mentions a thurible, which is metal container used to burn incense. The altar server who caries the thurible is called the thurifer, and they must swing the thurible a certain number of times depending on the occasion. The chasuble Stephen mentions is an article of clothing worn by a priest when celebrating mass. It is sleeveless and worn as an outer vestment.
Learn more about the priest’s vestments and what they all mean in this video:
